## Think About It

1. What does Ruby want all the time? (Everything RIGHT NOW.) 2. What does Ruby notice when she sits still? (A butterfly, a worm, carrot tops waving.) 3. What lesson does Ruby learn? (Patience — some things are better when you wait.)
